formal: I started a new blood pressure tablet one month ago, and it causes me to feel slightly dizzy when I stand up. My next appointment is in six weeks. The plan is for me to cut the tablets in half myself until that appointment. I rarely bring health questions of this kind to you, so asking now is unusual for me. I am unable to determine whether the dizziness is of greater importance than the full dose, so I shall proceed with the plan without making a decision of my own. What is your view?
